title: 咖啡店打工第一天
subtitle: 12 句英文，第一天上班不當機

lines.say: Hi, can I get an oat flat white to take away?
lines.zh: 嗨，我要一杯外帶的燕麥奶 flat white。

lines.say: Eh… yes!
lines.zh: 呃……好！

lines.say: On my first day in a café, a customer said all that, and I only understood hi.
lines.zh: 我第一天在咖啡店打工，客人講了一串，我只聽懂 hi。

lines.say: So I gave him a hot chocolate.
lines.zh: 結果，我給了他一杯熱巧克力。

board.kicker: How do you say my name?

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev!
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！

lines.say: It's spelled N, I, A, M, H, but we say Neev. Irish names make no sense!
lines.zh: 拼作 N-I-A-M-H，卻唸作「妮芙」。愛爾蘭名字就是不講道理！
lines.cap: It's spelled N, I, A, M, H, but we say Niamh. Irish names make no sense!

board.cta: 咖啡店打工第一天・12 句

lines.say: Today, I'll teach you twelve sentences for your first day in a café.
lines.zh: 今天教你十二句話，第一天去咖啡店上班就用得上。

lines.say: So you won't freeze like I did. Ready? Let's go!
lines.zh: 這樣你就不會像我一樣當機。準備好了嗎？出發！

scenes.title: Taking an order
scenes.sub: 接單：三句話接完一張單

lines.say: Part one: taking an order.
lines.zh: 第一段：接單。

lines.say: A customer walks up to you. What do you say first?
lines.zh: 客人走到櫃檯，你第一句要說什麼？

lines.say: Your textbook says: May I help you? It's correct, but too formal for a café.
lines.zh: 課本教 May I help you？沒有錯，但在咖啡店太正式了。

lines.say: This is what we really say.
lines.zh: 我們真正說的是這一句。

lines.say: What can I get you?
It means: what would you like? It's friendly and relaxed.
lines.zh: 意思是：想喝點什麼？語氣親切又輕鬆。

lines.say: Say it with a smile, and you already sound like a pro.
lines.zh: 帶著微笑說，聽起來就很專業。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: What can I get you?

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: Is that to have here or take away?
scenes.note: 美國 to go ＝ 愛爾蘭 take away

lines.say: After they order, ask this.
lines.zh: 客人點完之後，問這一句。

lines.say: Is that to have here or take away?
Have here means you drink it in the café. Take away means you bring it with you.
lines.zh: have here 是內用，take away 是外帶。

lines.say: Careful! Americans say to go. In Ireland and the UK, we say take away.
lines.zh: 注意！美國人說 to go，愛爾蘭和英國說 take away。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Is that to have here or take away?

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.note: 多問一句，多賣一塊蛋糕

lines.say: Before they pay, ask one more question.
lines.zh: 結帳之前，再多問一句。

lines.say: Anything else for you?
It means: do you want something more?
lines.zh: 意思是：還需要別的嗎？

lines.say: Your boss will love you, because people often add a cake!
lines.zh: 老闆會很愛你，因為客人常常就多買一塊蛋糕！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Anything else for you?
Let's watch a full order.
lines.zh: 來看一次完整的接單。

lines.say: Hi there! What can I get you?
lines.zh: 嗨！想喝點什麼？

lines.say: A cappuccino, please.
lines.zh: 一杯卡布奇諾，謝謝。

lines.say: Is that to have here or take away?
lines.zh: 內用還是外帶？

lines.say: Take away, please.
lines.zh: 外帶，謝謝。

lines.say: Anything else for you?
lines.zh: 還需要別的嗎？

lines.say: No, that's all, thanks.
lines.zh: 不用，這樣就好，謝謝。

lines.say: See? Three sentences, and the order is done.
lines.zh: 看，三句話，一張單就接完了。

scenes.title: I didn't catch that
scenes.sub: 聽不懂：客人講太快怎麼辦？

lines.say: Part two. The customer talks really fast, and you don't understand.
lines.zh: 第二段。客人講話超快，你完全沒聽懂。

lines.say: What now?
lines.zh: 怎麼辦？

lines.say: Please, never say: What?
lines.zh: 拜託，千萬不要說 What？

lines.say: And never say: Again! It sounds rude.
lines.zh: 也不要說 Again！聽起來很沒禮貌。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: Sorry, could you say that again?
scenes.meaning: 不好意思，可以再說一次嗎？
scenes.note: 開頭加 Sorry，立刻變客氣

lines.say: Here is the polite way.
lines.zh: 客氣的說法是這一句。

lines.say: Sorry, could you say that again?
It means: please repeat that.
lines.zh: 意思是：請再說一次。

lines.say: Start with sorry, and the whole sentence becomes polite.
lines.zh: 開頭加 Sorry，整句話立刻變客氣。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Sorry, could you say that again?

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: Sorry, was that an oat flat white?
scenes.note: Was that ＋ 你聽到的東西

lines.say: Here's a smarter trick. Repeat what you heard, and let the customer check it.
lines.zh: 更厲害的一招：把你聽到的重複一次，讓客人確認。

lines.say: Sorry, was that an oat flat white?
Say was that, then the thing you heard.
lines.zh: 先說 was that，再接你聽到的東西。

lines.say: You sound very professional. Really, you're just guessing!
lines.zh: 聽起來超專業，其實你只是在猜！

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Sorry, was that an oat flat white?

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: Bear with me, it's my first day.
scenes.meaning: 請多包涵，我第一天上班
scenes.note: bear with me ＝ 請對我有點耐心

lines.say: And if everything goes wrong, use this magic sentence.
lines.zh: 如果真的手忙腳亂，就用這句神奇的話。

lines.say: Bear with me, it's my first day.
Bear with me means: please be patient with me.
lines.zh: bear with me 意思是：請對我有點耐心。

lines.say: Say this, and almost every customer will smile at you.
lines.zh: 說出這句，幾乎每個客人都會對你微笑。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Bear with me, it's my first day.
A little secret: I used this sentence for a whole month.
lines.zh: 偷偷告訴你，這句話我用了整整一個月。

scenes.title: Oops!
scenes.sub: 出包了：道歉・解決・加碼

lines.say: Part three. One day, you will make the wrong drink. I promise!
lines.zh: 第三段。你總有一天會做錯飲料，我保證！

lines.say: What matters is what you say next.
lines.zh: 重點是接下來怎麼說。

items: ② Fix it fast　馬上解決
③ A little extra　加碼

lines.say: Remember three steps. One: say sorry.
lines.zh: 記住三個步驟。第一，道歉。

lines.say: Two: fix it fast.
lines.zh: 第二，馬上解決。

lines.say: Three: give a little extra.
lines.zh: 第三，加碼。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.note: so sorry 比 very sorry 更真心

lines.say: Step one: say sorry.
lines.zh: 第一步，道歉。

lines.say: I'm so sorry about that.
It shows you really feel bad about it.
lines.zh: 表示你真的覺得很抱歉。

lines.say: Say so sorry, not very sorry. So sounds more honest.
lines.zh: 說 so sorry，不要說 very sorry。so 聽起來比較真心。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'm so sorry about that.

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: I'll make you a fresh one straight away.

lines.say: Step two: fix it fast.
lines.zh: 第二步，馬上解決。

lines.say: I'll make you a fresh one straight away.
A fresh one means a new drink.
lines.zh: a fresh one 就是重做一杯新的。

lines.say: And straight away means right now. We say it a lot in Ireland.
lines.zh: straight away 是立刻，愛爾蘭人很常說。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I'll make you a fresh one straight away.

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.note: on the house ＝ 店家招待

lines.say: Step three, if your boss says yes: give a little extra.
lines.zh: 第三步，如果老闆同意，可以加碼。

lines.say: This one's on the house.
On the house means the café pays for it.
lines.zh: on the house 是店家招待，由店裡請客。

lines.say: But ask your boss first, or you will be the one paying!
lines.zh: 但要先問老闆，不然付錢的就是你！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: This one's on the house.
Excuse me, I asked for oat milk.
lines.zh: 不好意思，我點的是燕麥奶。

lines.say: I'm so sorry about that.
lines.zh: 真的很抱歉。

lines.say: I'll make you a fresh one straight away.
lines.zh: 我馬上幫你重做一杯。

lines.say: Ah, no bother. Thanks!
lines.zh: 啊，沒關係，謝謝！

scenes.title: With your team
scenes.sub: 跟同事：尖峰時間的三句話

lines.say: Part four. You also need to talk to your coworkers.
lines.zh: 第四段。你還要跟同事溝通。

lines.say: When it's busy, everyone speaks in short sentences.
lines.zh: 忙的時候，大家講話都很短。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: Can you give me a hand?
scenes.note: give me a hand ＝ 幫個忙

lines.say: When you have too much to do, say this.
lines.zh: 忙不過來的時候，說這一句。

lines.say: Can you give me a hand?
Give me a hand means: help me.
lines.zh: give me a hand 意思是：幫我一下。

lines.say: You're not asking for a real hand, of course!
lines.zh: 當然不是真的要一隻手！

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Can you give me a hand?

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: Can you mind the till for a sec?
scenes.note: till ＝ 收銀台　for a sec ＝ 一下下

lines.say: When you need to leave the counter, say this.
lines.zh: 要離開櫃檯的時候，說這一句。

lines.say: Can you mind the till for a sec?
The till is where the money goes. Mind it means: watch it for me.
lines.zh: till 是收銀台。mind 是幫我顧著。

lines.say: And for a sec means for a very short time.
lines.zh: for a sec 是一下下。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Can you mind the till for a sec?
And the last one. It's the happiest sentence in the whole café!
lines.zh: 最後一句，也是全店最快樂的一句話！

lines.say: I'm going on my break.
Your break is your rest time at work.
lines.zh: break 就是上班中間的休息時間。

lines.say: Everyone loves saying this one.
lines.zh: 每個人都超愛說這句。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'm going on my break.

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：加碼送你兩句

lines.say: One more thing! Here are two bonus phrases, only in Ireland.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！送你兩句愛爾蘭限定。

lines.say: When customers get their coffee, they often don't say thank you. They say this.
lines.zh: 客人拿到咖啡，常常不說 thank you，而是說這句。

lines.say: Thanks a million!
A million thanks! It sounds big, but people here say it every day.
lines.zh: 一百萬個感謝！聽起來很誇張，但這裡的人每天都這樣說。

lines.say: So what do you say back? Not: you're welcome.
lines.zh: 那你要怎麼回？不是 You're welcome。

lines.say: No bother!
It means: no problem at all. Say it, and you're half Irish already!
lines.zh: 意思是：完全不麻煩。說出這句，你就是半個愛爾蘭人了！

lines.say: No bother!

scenes.title: All together
scenes.sub: 總複習：跟著店員一起唸

lines.say: Now let's put it all together in one scene. Say the lines with me!
lines.zh: 現在用一場戲把今天的句子串起來。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: What can I get you?
lines.zh: 想喝點什麼？

lines.say: An oat flat white, please.
lines.zh: 一杯燕麥奶 flat white，謝謝。

lines.say: Sorry, could you say that again?
lines.zh: 不好意思，可以再說一次嗎？

lines.say: An oat flat white.
lines.zh: 一杯燕麥奶 flat white。

lines.say: Is that to have here or take away?
lines.zh: 內用還是外帶？

lines.say: Take away. Thanks a million!
lines.zh: 外帶。太感謝了！

lines.say: No bother!
lines.zh: 不麻煩！

items: Is that to have here or take away?
Sorry, could you say that again?
Sorry, was that an oat flat white?
Bear with me, it's my first day.
I'll make you a fresh one straight away.
Can you give me a hand?
Can you mind the till for a sec?

lines.say: Brilliant! You got the job!
lines.zh: 太棒了，你被錄取了！

lines.say: Here are all twelve sentences. Take a screenshot, and read them before work.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡。截圖存起來，上班前再看一次。

board.cta: 打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文

lines.say: I'm Neev. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.
lines.zh: 我是 Niamh 老師。打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文。
lines.cap: I'm Niamh. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.

lines.say: And now, I'm going on my break. See you next time. Bye!
lines.zh: 現在，我要去休息了。下一課見，Bye！
